about_the_game:
You don’t remember how you ended up here.
But V.E.R.A. — the enigmatic AI overseeing your journey — is already speaking.

Calm.                            Sharp.                          Sarcastic.

The demo version features the laboratory’s introductory sector — a controlled tutorial environment designed to familiarize you with neural driving protocols, puzzle interaction, and the mood of V.E.R.A.’s commentary.


Your objective is to unlock the main gate, sealed behind a two-part bell mechanism. Only by ringing both bells can you proceed… and glimpse the world beyond. This is the boundary of the demo — a taste of the height, challenge, and mystery that await.

Key Features:

🧠 Experimental Vehicle Mechanics
Rotate mid-air. Shift trajectory instantly.
And, yes — use a built-in miniature time machine.

🎭 Narrative with Layers (and Wires)
Who built this place? Why are you here?
Why does V.E.R.A. sound like she’s not just guiding, but remembering?

💬 V.E.R.A., Your Reluctant Companion
She’ll mock. She’ll admire. She’ll glitch.
And maybe — just maybe — she cares.

⚠️ High-Speed Precision Required
One wrong move can mean falling far.
But failure is just another trajectory to test.

Find the perfect trajectory. Learn the truth.
And don’t let V.E.R.A. erase your memory… again.

Are you ready to defy the simulation?

Post-Speed — it’s a race for truth you can’t escape. 🧩⚡🚗
